role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 召唤出他的烈狱魔像，术士为敌人们带来毁灭，将他们的防御工事摧毁殆尽。然而即使没有魔像，他吟唱暗黑魔法还能破坏敌阵，只靠一句咒语就能治疗盟友，伤害敌人，或者让敌人相互连接，共同负担受到的痛苦。
hero_summary_en: Summoning forth his demonic golem, Warlock brings ruin to enemies and destroys their defenses. Yet even without his golem, his dark spells can still wreak havoc, whether healing allies and harming enemies with a word, or binding foes together to share their agony.

abilities.name: warlock_fatal_bonds
abilities.description_zh: 将数个可见的敌方单位连接在一起，其中一人所受伤害的一定百分比会被其他所有人感受到。
abilities.description_en: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.
notes_zh: 共享伤害的类型与原伤害相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
notes_en: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: warlock_shadow_word
abilities.description_zh: 术士低声说出一个咒语，对一个单位施展法术，使周围的敌方单位受到伤害，周围的友方单位被治疗。目标单位也会被治疗或受到伤害，取决于他是友军还是敌人。
abilities.description_en: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.

scepter_loc.en: Increases Effect Radius. Shadow Word now applies to %additional_targets% additional units in a %cast_aoe% radius, prioritizing heroes. The healing and damage on the additional targets is reduced by %secondary_reduction%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升作用范围。现在暗言术会施加给%cast_aoe%范围内%additional_targets%个额外单位，以英雄优先。额外单位的治疗和伤害量减少%secondary_reduction%%%。

abilities.name: warlock_upheaval
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 随施法时间增强的减速气流，还会造成伤害。持续最多%abilitychanneltime%秒。在魔法结束或目标离开生效区域后，敌人仍会被减速%duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Enemies are slowed for %duration% second after leaving the area or the spell ends.
notes_zh: 减速效果的增加是根据持续施法的时长，而不是敌人在区内停留的持续时间。
notes_en: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.

shard_loc.en: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every %imps_interval% seconds that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.
shard_loc.zh: 持续施法时每%imps_interval%秒术士会召唤一个魔童，持续%minor_imp_duration%秒，魔童死亡时会爆炸，对周围所有敌人造成伤害。

abilities.name: warlock_eldritch_summoning
abilities.description_zh: 只要敌方单位在受到一个或多个术士的技能作用下阵亡，就会召唤出一个魔童，持续%minor_imp_duration%秒，死亡时会爆炸。魔童会自动搜寻附近单位，优先选择致命连接下的英雄，到达猎物时就会爆炸。
abilities.description_en: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.

shard_loc.en: Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.
shard_loc.zh: 提升小魔童的生命值和爆炸伤害。

abilities.name: warlock_rain_of_chaos
abilities.description_zh: 从深渊召唤一个地狱火，眩晕敌人%stun_duration%秒。地狱火持续%golem_duration%秒，能够减免部分技能的伤害，具有较高的减速抗性，拥有永久献祭和烈焰之拳技能。
abilities.description_en: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds. The Golem lives %golem_duration% seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
notes_zh: 该技能将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
notes_en: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.
facet_text_en: Chaotic Offering Golems deal more burn damage based on Warlock's health and mana regeneration.
facet_text_zh: 混乱之祭地狱火会根据术士的生命和魔法恢复造成更高的永久献祭伤害。
